temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days during a busy week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if something is wrong, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; her recent quietness is uncharacteristic and may mean something is bothering her, but Carolyn does not yet know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn confirms that she is dealing with work and personal stress, and she does not reject Carolyn's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is under significant work and personal stress, and Carolyn's supportive check-in was acceptable to her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and be available to listen without pushing too hard.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Carolyn's initial approach, Marilyn responds curtly in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and slightly hurt. Carolyn then shares her own tough experiences and says she hopes she did not overstep. Marilyn apologizes and says she has had a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is stressed by work and personal issues, and she accepted Carolyn's earlier concern, so Carolyn expects their interactions to remain supportive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness makes Carolyn question whether she overstepped or caused a rift; Marilyn's explanation suggests the curtness was due to her hard week, not personal rejection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's curtness was likely caused by stress rather than by Carolyn, and Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's support; the misunderstanding can be repaired.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and slightly hurt, then reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up any misunderstanding, show support, and avoid overstepping Marilyn's boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appears to respond positively to Carolyn's openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend get-together, Marilyn accepts warmly and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes the earlier misunderstanding has been eased and feels relieved and hopeful about a budding friendship with Marilyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's positive response and acceptance of the invitation indicate she is open to a closer social connection.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in building a friendship outside work and values Carolyn's invitation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship and include Marilyn in a small social gathering.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn still keeps a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this directly, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes their friendship is developing and that the positive outside-work connection may carry into a warmer professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Carolyn learns that the perceived workplace distance may be unintentional on Marilyn's part, and Marilyn is willing to discuss and improve their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There may still be a workplace distance, but it is not necessarily personal or fixed; Carolyn can address it directly and work toward better collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then somewhat reassured by Marilyn's willingness to talk.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To discuss their work dynamic, clarify expectations, and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. When Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and says she is glad they talked and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and now better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic and wants to further the partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms that she values the clarified relationship and wants to collaborate more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn have a clearer mutual understanding of professional expectations and personal boundaries, and their partnership is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To collaborate with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
